content: Resolved the open question over the four Pmcro__* env vars with real evidence rather than guessing: grepped all three .NET projects (zero consumers), noticed Pmcro__SkillsRoot was a literal empty-string placeholder, and read CONTEXT.md's own statement that the deterministic engine does not create a parallel orchestration engine -- three converging signals pointed to removal, not wiring. Removed the dead config from AppHost.cs (commit b5660f7) and verified the build still succeeds (0 errors). Deliberately did not invent a next_seed proposing live PMCR-O tool access for the Runtime chat agent, since no evidence (design doc, consumer, or user request) shows anyone wants that yet -- filing a speculative seed would repeat the same mistake this session already corrected once (the pmcro-aspire MCP-server assumption built from inference instead of verification).
